# Methods on an embeddable base that call a sibling method on their own
# receiver. Go has no virtual dispatch, so these resolve to the BASE's method
# and ignore any override with the same signature.
#
# None of these is live today: every embedder either overrides the caller too,
# or its same-named method has a DIFFERENT signature and is a wrapper rather
# than an override. They are one signature-matching override away from being
# real, which is why they are listed rather than forgotten.
#
# This list may only SHRINK. Empty is the destination.
dao/dialect_generic.go	GenericDialect.BuildUpsertSuffix -> QuoteIdent
tui/container.go	MultiChild.Add -> name
tui/container.go	MultiChild.Move -> indexOf
tui/container.go	MultiChild.Move -> name
tui/container.go	MultiChild.remove -> indexOf
tui/container.go	MultiChild.Remove -> remove
tui/stack.go	Stack.AddAligned -> setLayer
tui/stack.go	Stack.AddAt -> setLayer
tui/widget/textbuffer.go	textBuffer.cellsAt -> lineClusters
tui/widget/textbuffer.go	textBuffer.clampCol -> lineClusters
tui/widget/textbuffer.go	textBuffer.colForCells -> lineClusters
tui/widget/textbuffer.go	textBuffer.deleteRegion -> lineClusters
tui/widget/textbuffer.go	textBuffer.insertText -> deleteRegion
tui/widget/textbuffer.go	textBuffer.insertText -> lineClusters
tui/widget/textbuffer.go	textBuffer.insertText -> selection
tui/widget/textbuffer.go	textBuffer.moveCursor -> clampCol
tui/widget/textbuffer.go	textBuffer.textIn -> lineClusters
tui/widget/textbuffer.go	textBuffer.verticalTarget -> cellsAt
tui/widget/textbuffer.go	textBuffer.verticalTarget -> colForCells
tui/widget/textbuffer.go	textBuffer.wordLeft -> lineClusters
tui/widget/textbuffer.go	textBuffer.wordRight -> lineClusters
